info.name: Hotmart API — OrganicEcom
info.description:
Minimal Hotmart API surface used by OrganicEcom (subscriber verification + auth).

Source contracts:
- docs/contracts/hotmart.md
- docs/contracts/hotmart.openapi.yaml

**Setup:**
1. Import the companion environment file (hotmart.postman_environment.json).
2. Fill in `client_id`, `client_secret`, and `basic_token` with your credentials from https://app-vlc.hotmart.com/tools/credentials
3. Fill in `product_id` with your 7-digit mentorship product ID.
4. Run "Auth / Get Access Token" — the `access_token` variable will be set automatically by the test script.
5. Use the subscription endpoints. Any request that gets a 401 should re-run the auth step first.

request.description:
Used by HM-003 to verify a logged-in user has an ACTIVE subscription to the mentorship product.

**Authorization logic:** a user is an authorized student if the response contains at least one item with `status == "ACTIVE"` for the configured `product_id`.

Other statuses (OVERDUE, INACTIVE, CANCELLED_*, STARTED, DELAYED) → unauthorized.

**Tip:** pass `max_results=1` + `subscriber_email` for fastest single-user check.

**Rate limit:** 500 req/min. Headers: RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset.

request.description:
Lists all subscribers for a product. Supports cursor-based pagination via `page_token`.

The test script automatically stores `next_page_token` in the environment for chained pagination.

All optional query params are included as disabled entries — enable them as needed.

Subscription/subscriber endpoints. All requests use `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`.
